comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/JirayaaaBoyy106 please add details on how AI was used to make this. Just stating that you used AI doesn't pass the rule. The community is a dev community, add dev details. Rule 4 is there to make sure promotional posts contribute by getting into the process and actual development. There's a real risk of the sub being swamped by self-promotion. If you don't update, this post may be removed.

replies.author: YinkciHeart
replies.body: Just remove it, even after reading your comment OP still dont want to add details. This is just pure promotion.

comments.author: YasinTohan
comments.body:
Really nice work. I checked out the game, and I have to say the visuals look absolutely beautiful. You’ve done a great job with the overall presentation.

One small thing I noticed: when I searched for the game by its name, it was a little difficult to find because several other games with the same name showed up in the results. Maybe that's something worth considering for discoverability.

I also checked out your other game, Food Merge, and I really loved the store screenshots there as well. They look polished, eye-catching, and do a great job of showcasing the game.

Overall, great work on both projects. You can really see the effort and care that went into them. Keep it up, and wishing you lots of success 🙌
